name: Sacred Cloth
objectiveText: Bring 2 Mooncloth to Meilosh in Timbermaw Hold. Mooncloth  ( 2 )

comments.body:
you can grind your way to friendly to get the mooncloth boots pattern by killing winterfall den watchers and shamen in winterfall village just east of everlook. this has the following advantages:
1. they spawn quite fast so you can just run round in circles and kill, kill, kill.
2. they drop money (1-8s per kill) but few items
3. there is an 8 hour named spawn that drops items worth putting in the ah
4. there are 4 chest spawns in the village that give items for ah and vendor
5. there is an elite in the cave at the top that gives extra faction points
6. everlook is really close for repairs, vendor, letterbox and bank
7. they are all high enough level to still give you faction points at lvl 60
8. you can do the second quest for wintersaber trainers at the same time.

notes:
a) each normal kill gives 5 faction points. to get you from the beginning of unfriendly through neutral into friendly will take 1200 kills. a bit less if you kill the named and elite a few times.
doing anything to harm timbermaw will give you a disproportionate faction reduction
b) like someone said, there are quests in winterspring which give timbermaw faction as well. can't remember which ones, though. =)
c) don't do the repeatable quests. it is quicker to just kill than ride back and forth for a few points
d) if you group, everyone gets full faction points for a kill, but ONLY if you landed at least one hit on the mob
e) at honored (i think) you can get an enchanting recipe for +15 agi

hope that clears things up
turicus, <the care bears>, madmortem eu

edit: if you want the boots made /w me =)

[b]
According to wowwiki.com, there are two requirements:

1) Must be friendly status
2) Must be a tailor[/b]

Someone above me may have said it, but I couldn't find it.  That's the reason I put it in bold :)
For some reason this doesn't show up when you do a search for tailoring patterns from quests rewards.

I confirmed that you need "friendly" with Timbermaw to get this pattern, not honored.

Getting honored will allow you to speak with Gorn One-Eye, who as far as I can tell, is just a weapon vendor (I am inclined to believe that he might give a high level trade pattern, non-tailor, much like Meilosh gives a tailor pattern, but I don't know that for sure, just a hunch).  He has a few interesting items you can buy, with some interesting stats, but nothing I'd recommend a level 60 character to equip.  The items are also bind-on-pickup.

Also, the "pattern" you receive from Meilosh isn't a pattern at all, he just teaches it to you (i.e. you don't receive an item).  I was 300 at the time.  I think it's a safe bet to say you need to be a 300 tailor as the item is orange in the tailor list.

Kernda cannot be spoken to with honored faction.  Maybe revered/exalted, but I've had enough of killing thousands of Deadwood Furbolgs.

Also something interesting.  There are a TON of Timbermaw in Azshara whose camps have chests.  Getting neutral or higher faction will allow you to loot these chests.  They growl, but don't attack, and there is no faction hit.  Just fyi if you feel like making some easy money.
replies: Gorn One Eye will give you a quest to get a trinket once you are exalted with timbermaw. After reveared, the only thing that gains you rep is quest turn ins (this means feathers and spirit beads). The trinket is what I'm going for and yes it takes forever if you grind by yourself, but when you have a group, it goes by quickly.

replies:
This is incorrect.. here is the correct information.

The Winterfall activity quest yields 75 reputation upon completion, but requires the killing of 18 furbolgs, 6 of three times, as was stated. However, you do still receive reputation for killing these eighteen..
18*5=90
+75 rep for quest
=165 reputatioon every time you complete the quest. If you want to get from friendly to honored,
6000/165=36.3636....etc.

But since you can't do the quest 36.36 times.. if you do the quest 36 times and kill 12 extra furbolgs from the moment you acquire friendly, you'll get to honored.
